sentences.text:
2 . This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail relating to Crime No.213/2022, registered at Police Station Khetiya, District Barwani (M.P.) for offence under Sections 363, 366(A), 368, 376,
376(2)(n), 305, 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and also Section 66 of the I.T. Act.

The applicant is in custody since 25.09.2022.
3.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he has committed rape upon the prosecutrix.

The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C. in which she has stated that she wants to marry with the applicant but due to objections of her parents, she has consumed poison unfortunately she has expired but the applicant remained Harshal @ Hasrat @ Sharad @ Hasrai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199731457/
1 alive on the basis of which the applicant has been implicated and arrested for the present offence.
4 .

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C. before the trial Court.
The applicant is in custody since 25.09.2022.
Conclusion of trial will take a sufficient long time.

Under these circumstances,
counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

5. Learned Government Advocate opposed the application and submitted that the father of the prosecutrix has submitted an affidavit before the Advocate General Office and objecting his bail application.

6. In reply learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that certainly the father of the prosecutrix file his objection but looking to the facts of the case and custody period of the applicant,
he be released on bail.

7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C., considering the period of custody of the applicant and that the final conclusion of trial will take considerable time, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on bail.
Consequently without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

8. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
9.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE Shilpa Harshal @ Hasrat @ Sharad @ Hasrai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199731457/
